title: Casper and the Current
author: Astrid Nystrom
blurb: Noor Okafor, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
